entries.title: Paired-Slot Slide Specimen Case
entries.description: One original static visual specimen-slide case with a continuous thick base and four walls, two continuous comb rails carrying six aligned pairs of true upward-open slots, and three original opaque blank rectangular plates seated in alternating slot pairs. Each plate has two complete finite lower-corner bearing patches; its entire central lower edge remains above the case floor. The other three slot pairs remain wholly empty. A single thick shallow-recessed lid is frozen rearward raised, supported by two true two-ear through-bore assemblies, continuous headed pins, complete ear pedestals and two finite angle stops. Original shell, rails, plates and lid geometry; no recoloured bait-box compartments, circular eyepiece holes, copied pipette fork or resized suitcase. One complete prop, not separate plate assets. Metres, source Z up, front -Y, horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. Constant opaque PBR only; no texture nodes, linked Principled inputs, external geometry, labels, biological material, personal samples or microscopy pictures. Fixed visual geometry only: no standard slide compatibility, scientific sample preservation, sterile/sealed/temperature-controlled storage, pathology, diagnosis, optical performance, opening or loading trajectory, manufacturing, structural performance or laboratory safety claim.

entries.description: One original empty three-post industrial corner shelf with two continuous thick right-triangular shelf plates, two complete open triangular underframes, six separate finite horizontal support brackets, three full-height uprights, three flat feet and two complete diagonal braces on perpendicular back sides. The front diagonal remains open. Each complete underframe top bears on its shelf underside; each frame corner bears finitely on its own bracket; each bracket has a complete finite cut-end root on its post. Posts remain clear of the shelf edges. Eighteen closed editable meshes, four constant opaque unlinked Principled PBR materials. Metres, source Z up, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin and open front toward +X/-Y. Newly authored original shapes and assembly, not two rotated straight racks, a scaled old stage or a stripped corner cabinet. One full straight fixed square column joins that bearer to one continuous low H-shaped base. Four thick flat feet support the two complete runners.
